title: Creative Cartridge
user: Parents setting up an old computer for a 4–7-year-old who want a finite, offline creative play space rather than an internet feed.
smallest_useful_product: A downloadable PWA bundle with six tiny local activities (sound painting, shape stories, camera-free stop-motion cards, rhythm pads), a parent PIN for cartridge selection, and an offline health check.
monetization: one-time — content packs have clear finite value and the safety proposition is stronger without ongoing child profiling.
constraints: No collection of child data; fully usable offline after installation; large assets need a small-download mode; parent PIN is a convenience, not a security boundary.
